segments.en: Pentagona Continent

<Enemy Faction>
Poseidal Regular Army

<Allied Faction>
Rebel Army
Pentagona Continent

<Enemy Faction>
Rebel Army

<Allied Faction>
Poseidal Regular Army

There should be a base for our allies
somewhere in this town...

Hostile units sighted!
They're ordering us to halt!

Whoa, whoa...
Don't tell me this is an enemy trap.
No, it's not that...

Every town on this continent
is controlled by the Poseidal Army.

The only way into town
is to drive the enemy out by force.
Guess so...

The enemy forces have been
driven off.
You can now dock at Trydetol.

rows.notes: [editorial 0] same message as elsewhere (10352 11.0); was 'Enemy forces repelled.'

segments.en: I'm Semuge, leader of our rebel army.

Let's fight together
to bring down Poseidal!
We look forward to working with you!

Alliance formed with the rebel army
of the Pentagona Continent.

Straight to business, then:
I need you to fly to Mizun.

That's where you'll find
the true leader of the rebels.
The true leader?
You'll understand once you reach Mizun.

Understood.
We'll head for Mizun once we depart.
This is Mizun, isn't it?

No doubt about it.
This is Mizun.
Hostile units sighted!
The enemy fleet is withdrawing.

Splendid...!
With this, we can stand up
to the Poseidal Army!

The enemy forces have been
driven off.
You can now dock at Mizun.

Mr. Semuge, the person you wanted
us to meet is...?

He should be here already.
Follow me.
Allow me to introduce him!

Heir to the royal blood of the Yaman people,
the true leader of our rebel army...
Daba Myroad!
I'm Daba Myroad.

To stand against the Redros Army,
which threatens the peace of the world,
I'll fight alongside you all!
Thank you for your cooperation!
Well, let's skip the stiff formalities.

For now, it's down with Poseidal!
Let's get a move on!
Who put YOU in charge?!
What's wrong with that?
Right, Daba?
Yeah.
Geez! You're okay with that, Daba?
Sure.

Besides, I get the feeling we'll
get along well with these people.

Somehow, they've got the same
vibe as us, huh...

The leaders are in completely
different leagues.
Uh... maybe so...

But... the rebels don't have enough
experience in organized warfare.

These people, on the other hand,
have had proper military training.

Yeah... Leccee's right.
There's a lot we should learn from them.

Hmm...
So your name's Leccee...

You came up through the regular army,
didn't you?

Gaw Ha Leccee.
I'm an ex-soldier, more or less.
I thought so...

I'm Nelfea Northrock.
I think you and I will get along.
Oh?

Nice to meet you,
young lady.
Joined up with Daba's group.

rows.notes: Seg 18 [jp] read as [jp] (caliber); Nelfea contrasts the two groups' leaders, Rie concedes. Seg 29 (blank header after Leccee's line) taken as Leccee calling Nelfea [jp].

segments.en:
Daba, where's the enemy's
main force?

The Poseidal Army's main force
is in the capital, Sveto.
Are we going to attack them right away?

Poseidal has joined hands with
the Redros Army and is building
up strength.

If we dawdle,
our casualties will only mount.
Good point...

Daba, there's no need
to be in such a hurry.

Now that we have warships to carry
our forces, we can attack Sveto anytime.

Before that, why not form
an alliance with Theart Star?

Once Poseidal is beaten, we'll still
have to fight the Redros Army.

If we're in this for the long haul,
we'll want Theart Star's support.

Whether she'll agree
to negotiate with us...

That I can't say, but once she sees
our strength now, she may be moved
to act.

In other words, we've gotta show
them what we can do!

We take out Giwaza's army
deployed in Koam's airspace.

Even if we attack Sveto, there's a risk
Giwaza will hit us from behind.
So we should crush them first.
Which one should we attack first...
Launching the operation.

Targets: the capital, "Sveto,"
and the province of "Koam."

Both regions must be taken
to liberate the Pentagona Continent.
Displaying markers.

rows.notes: Seg 3: no pronoun for Poseidal (the ruler's gender is ambiguous in this game). Seg 11 [jp] = Full Flat (female, queen of Theart Star). Seg 7 (blank header, polite [jp]) kept as Semuge continuing. Sveto follows the library spelling ([jp]).

segments.en:
The alliance with the Poseidal
Regular Army has deepened.

You can now deploy the Poseidal
Regular Army's forces.

rows.notes: [accuracy 0] [jp] is 'alliance', not general 'relations' | [editorial 0] stray '/' in the text; worded like the Titans message (10350 19.5)

segments.en:
I am Quwasan Olibee, commander
of the Imperial Guard Division.

My words faithfully convey
the will of Lord Poseidal.
Heed them well.
Command us as you wish.

A rebel base has been discovered
in Trydetol.

Surround the city with your fleet
and put every last traitor to death!

With our army's strength,
that will be a simple matter.

I'll have an assault force
organized at once.

Lord Poseidal has granted you
the honor of this victory.
Swift action would be wise.
I'm well aware.

Please, enjoy a taste
of our army's true strength.

<Operation Launched>
Trydetol Assault

rows.notes: [editorial 12] operation-name format as the other cards ('GEAR HQ Assault')

segments.en: The battle will now begin.
Koam has been captured.
You can now dock.
So Daba Myroad defeated Giwaza...

Perhaps the time is ripe,
Miyau...
Lady Full Flat!
An envoy from Claudia is here.
About the alliance talks, I take it...
I'm coming.

I'm Rie Akatsuki.
Today, I've come...

I know.
We have our own intelligence network,
you see.
I'll get straight to the point.

Theart Star will form
an alliance with your forces.

From now on, we will have
no more dealings with the Redros Army.
Will that suffice?
Yes!
Um, th-thank you very much!

Heh...
I have high hopes for you.
Alliance formed with Theart Star.

rows.notes: [jp] not in glossary; romanized Miyau (someone Full Flat addresses; identity not verified). | [editorial 8] 'I'll give you my conclusion first' was a calque | [editorial 15] system-message template unified

segments.en: The battle will now begin.
Sveto has been captured.
Docking at Sveto.

Hey! Daba!
Where are you going?!
I'm going to look for Olibee!
Amm, help Kyao out!

Whaaat?!
I wanna go too!
Hey! Amm!

We've got our hands full here too!
Help out!!

Amm, we need your skills.
Sorry, but please give us a hand.

Ugh... geez!
What is with this?!

Hm!
You!!
Daba Myroad!

Relax.
Olibee is safe.
B... Big Brother...?
Olibee!
Big Brother...

Thank goodness...
Olibee!
Daba Myroad.
I'm going to lend the rebels my aid.
I can't believe you mean that.

Besides, we've already defeated
Poseidal. Why now...

Poseidal has gone off somewhere
with the Redros Army.
What did you say?
Poseidal will return someday.

For that day,
I will lend you all my strength.
That is what I've decided.

All right... Gablae,
let's fight together!
Right!
Alliance formed with Gablae's unit.

rows.notes: [accuracy 10] subject restored: Daba means 'we' (his side) beat Poseidal; passive dropped it | [editorial 10] literal slashes in the text replaced by spaces | [editorial 18] system-message template unified

segments.en:
Big Brother!
Hee hee hee hee.

Daba!
Has Olibee gotten
her memory back?

She's free of Poseidal's hold on her,
but... her memories and her mind
haven't come back...

Hee hee...
Big Brother...

Olibee is... already...
...not here anymore...
She's... gone...
Daba...
Daba... don't cry...
Giving up isn't like you, Daba!

The Daba I love would never,
ever give up!

Always looking forward... facing
anything head-on... That's Daba
Myroad! That's who you are!

That's right. After all,
Olibee is right here.
We mustn't give up...

Come on, get up! There must still
be lots of things that only you
can do, Daba!

That's right... There are things
I have to do.
I can't lose heart here!

rows.notes: Seg 19 source typo [jp] read as [jp]. Seg 20 blank header kept as Amm continuing.

segments.en: Incident on the Pentagona Continent.

Sveto has been seized by a combined
force of the Poseidal Army and
the Redros Army.
The battle will now begin.
Sveto has been captured.
Docking at Sveto.

So the Pentagona Continent's
been liberated, right?
Yeah.

And on top of that, we've driven
the Redros Army one step closer
to the wall.

Thank you. Thanks to everyone's
help, we were able to defeat Poseidal.

Now it's our turn to give it
everything we've got to bring down
the Redros Army.
That's what I like to hear!

At this point,
let's see this through to the end!
Glad to have you aboard!
The battle will now begin.

The rebels in Trydetol
have been suppressed.
A splendid performance.

Thanks to your work, we have
brought order to this continent.

From now on, the Pentagona Continent
will prosper as never before.
Thank you, sir.

However, we're only halfway there.
Let us move on to our next objective.
Indeed. I'm counting on you.

Enemy forces on the Pentagona
Continent have been wiped out.
Find your next objective.
